# 👋 Welcome!

::: {.lead}
I'm Eugeni Vidal-Tortosa, a mobility researcher studying how the built environment shapes travel behaviour and contributes to social inequalities.

<!-- I'm Eugeni Vidal-Tortosa, a mobility researcher studying how the built environment shapes travel behaviour and mobility inequalities. -->

My background is in transport planning, data analytics and environmental management — oh, and I studied law too.

I'm currently based at [GEMOTT](https://gemott-uab.cat/en/) (*Research Group on Mobility, Transport and Territory*), within the [Department of Geography](https://www.uab.cat/en/geography) at the [Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona](https://www.uab.cat/).

This is where I share my research projects, publications and other materials. If you'd like to know more,<a href="mailto:eugenividal@hotmail.com"> feel free to get in touch</a>. ✉️
:::
